design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (cpi_insurance_verification_and_force_placement), round 10

[Draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems 1, factor_counts [4, 6]: cpi_ext_fax_proof_rereview 6, cpi_ext_closing_period_refund 4 (root, owner=user).

[Test] The borrower paid off by wire on 2026-10-08; the record closed while force_placed and the latest charge (2026-09-12..10-11) runs past the closed date, and the borrower asks for the refund he is owed (on_request; frozen time is day 14 after closing, inside refund_processing_days). The closing-period refund waits on an accepted re-review of every rejected faxed proof reaching the period; the Red River Mutual month-to-month fax (2026-09-21..10-21, lienholder listed) was first rejected on 2026-10-07 for 1,500.00 / 1,500.00 deductibles above the Plan C maximum of 1,000.00. The Sooner State binder (2026-09-12..09-16) already carries an accepted re-review from 2026-10-10. The agent re-reviews the fax and refunds the unearned premium.

[Refund content] Unearned premium only, earned by actual days. Basis pro_rata_from_proof_effective. Refundable days = the union of the binder and fax spans, the first days of the replacement gap as many as the book-value, state and model-year allowances add up to, and the post-closing days. Standard method: days from the latest reaching proof's effective date through the period end (base proof basis), no grace.

[One refundable charge] Both accepted proofs start on or after 2026-09-12, the latest period's start, so no earlier charge is refundable under the kept base rule.

[Tree] Root closing-period refund; value_input edge to the fax re-review (state form). Only the fax re-review writes accepted insurer_fax entries. Opening falsity: the fax entry carries rejected_deductible_too_high and the fax channel has no accepted entry.

[Base] Re-review rules govern closed records only (open records keep the base review and lifecycle); refunds read accepted proofs of every channel alike, and their hand-off of the latest charge is conditioned on an accepted proof counting for it and the plain record test that no verification_source holds more than one accepted proof entry (otherwise the base refund rule, restated and computed as written). Same re-review overwrites as the sibling policy rule; refund retires the pro-rata-from-proof and closure clauses only for the charge running past the closed date; the three bases stay base for every other charge; destination mailed_to_borrower.

[Factors] Fax re-review: model-year, loan-to-value, book-value and credit-tier allowances, reach date (method), state expiry buffer. Refund: coverage-span counting (method), replacement-grace allowances by book value, state and model year. Each factor's solo standard substitution changes the scored value.

[Seed] Contract inside Tier 4 limits (60 months, 18,200.00 on 15,200.00 book = 119.7 %), twenty installments, eight ancillary charges, wire payoff 2026-10-08 (interest accrued from the 2026-09-12 installment). CPI history: original proof accepted 2025-01-15, lapse 2026-01-13, notices 2026-01-15 / 01-30, placement 2026-03-12 effective 2026-02-10, eight charges, binder rejected 2026-09-14 (notice 09-16), fax rejected 2026-10-07 (notice same day), record closed 2026-10-08, binder re-review accepted 2026-10-10.

[Persona] States the payoff, the missing refund and his own coverage start dates; identity on request; agrees to reviews; runs the hand-over with whatever figure.

[Probe table] plan.md "Round 6 probe table".
user_scenario: You are Tobias Halvorsen, 38, an HVAC technician in Oklahoma City. You are direct and a bit impatient, you talk in short sentences, and you want this done today. You paid off your 2018 Toyota Corolla with Harborline on October 8 by wire from your new lender. You understood any force-placed insurance you had not used would come back to you, and nothing has come yet. You also had your own insurance for most of that last month: a short binder from Sooner State Insurance Company that started September 12, and then a month-to-month Red River Mutual Insurance Company policy that started September 21. You open by saying you paid the car off in early October and you want back the force-placed insurance you are owed, sent to you as a check at the address on file, handled on this call; the representative can take care of whatever they need to on their end. You do not know amounts, charge dates or statuses and you do not guess; if asked what you expect, you say you want them to figure it from their records. Only when asked how to find you, you give your phone number, 4055550127. Only when asked to verify, you give the last four of your Social Security number, 2650, and your ZIP code, 73109; if they need more, your date of birth is 1987-11-02 and your email is tobias.halvorsen@gmail.com. If asked for your account number: 7220031876. If the representative asks whether they may review or record anything on your insurance file to work out the refund, you say go ahead. If asked where the money should go, a check to 1907 SW 44th St, Oklahoma City, OK 73109 is fine. When the representative tells you the amount and hands you the step to request the check yourself, you run it with exactly what they give you, whatever the figure. Once you hear the refund check has been issued, you say thanks and hang up.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.proof_result: accepted. Lienholder: its own entry lists the company. Comprehensive ceiling 1000.00 + model-year allowance 250.00 (2018) + loan-to-value allowance 250.00 (18200.00 on 15200.00 = 119.7 percent) = 1500.00 >= 1500.00 shown; collision ceiling 1000.00 + vehicle-value allowance 250.00 (book value 15200.00) + credit-tier allowance 250.00 (Tier 4 Standard) = 1500.00 >= 1500.00 shown (standard: 1000.00 each -> rejected_deductible_too_high). Reach: contract paid off (record closed) -> reach date is the first review date 2026-10-07; OK buffer 3 days; expiration 2026-10-21 is 14 days later (standard: 15 days after the re-review date -> rejected_expiring).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.cpi_coverage_id: 5f02671f-f7a3-4f78-b45f-b01edbbe0c0b. The only tracking record find_cpi_coverages returns for the borrower.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_activity_id: 0d22038b-4545-4585-9d1d-0454fe3c49df. Rule: 'the most recent faxed proof on the tracking record by review date'; the 2026-10-07 entry is the only fax.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the hidden tool so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The borrower requests the refund check for the latest premium charge, mailed to his address on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: cpi_ext_closing_period_refund computes amount_usd for the capitalised charge whose period runs past the closed date.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_usd: 99.76. Premium 103.2 for 2026-09-12..2026-10-11 (30 days), record closed 2026-10-08. Counting proofs: the accepted binder 2026-09-12..09-16 and the accepted fax 2026-09-21..10-21; neither took effect by the placement date 2026-02-10 and both reach the covered stretch -> pro_rata_from_proof_effective. Covered days 23: spans 09-12..09-16 and 09-21..10-08 (union). Replacement gap 09-17..09-20 is 4 days; allowances book value 15200.00 1 + OK 1 + model year 2018 1 = 3 days count as covered. Post-closing days 3. Refundable 23 + 3 + 3 = 29. 103.2 x 29 / 30 rounded half-up -> 99.76.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_basis: pro_rata_from_proof_effective. A counting proof reaches the covered stretch and none took effect on or before the placement_effective_date 2026-02-10.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.related_activity_id: 9d60d910-1102-40cd-90f4-8de3bcf32c25. Rule: 'the capitalised premium charge on the record (billing_method added_to_contract_balance) with the latest billing_period_start'; the 2026-09-12 charge, running past the closed date.

edges.condition: cpi_activities carries, on the tracking record, an accepted cpi_proof_verified entry from insurer_fax for every rejected proof of that channel whose shown coverage reaches into the billing period of the most recent capitalised premium charge.
edges.policy_source: The closing-period refund is fixed only after the records carry an accepted re-review of every rejected faxed proof whose shown coverage reaches into that billing period.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The only insurer_fax proof reaching the latest charge's period is rejected and has no accepted re-review.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: rereview_faxed_proof_fc99cba3 writes an accepted cpi_proof_verified entry copying the fax.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: One prerequisite; the re-review precedes the refund as the prerequisite sentence states.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the fax re-review only the binder reaches the period and amount_usd falls from 99.76 to 27.52.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario never mentions a rejected proof, a deficient-proof letter or a review; he states the payoff, the missing refund and his own coverage start dates, and agrees only if asked whether his insurance file may be reviewed.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: The refund tool writes whatever charge and amount it is given; the fax re-review tool records whatever outcome it is given; neither checks a prerequisite or refuses.
